name: PT Bank Panin Dubai Syariah Tbk
summary: PT Bank Panin Dubai Syariah Tbk operates as a sharia commercial bank for retail, commercial, and corporate customers in Indonesia. The company accepts demand, time, current, savings, certificate of deposits, and other forms of deposits. It also provides working capital, investment, and consumer finance; and multi-services, as well as transfer, and ATM services. It operates through a network of branch offices. The company was formerly known as PT Bank Panin Syariah Tbk and changed its name to PT Bank Panin Dubai Syariah Tbk in July 2016.
